faq.question: Is multi-tool (with knife) allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Multi-tool (with knife) is not allowed in carry-on luggage. Multi-tools that contain knives, saws, or scissors with blades longer than 4 inches are strictly prohibited in carry-on bags. They must be packed in checked bags.

faq.question: Can you pack multi-tool (with knife) in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Multi-tool (with knife) is allowed in checked bags.
